title: Wudu in Arabic
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: Common vocabulary: prepositions, questions and body parts
source: Seeded from arabic/y7 lesson 31 (Pupil PDF worksheet: wudu in Arabic)
intro: Lesson 31: Parts of the body (2): hands, feet and wudu. To understand and use Arabic words for the body, with duals and 'my', and describe wudu in Arabic

questions.model: Teacher: أَغْسِلُ (I wash) + ذِرَاعَيَّ (my two arms: dual with 'my').

questions.q: Write the steps of wudu in Arabic in the portal response box (six sentences in order, with ثُمَّ between steps). Group B adds the intention and bismillah at the start. Start: أَنْوِي ... ثُمَّ ...
questions.a: Six ordered sentences with correct body words and duals
questions.model: Teacher writes: أَقُولُ بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ، ثُمَّ أَغْسِلُ يَدَيَّ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ.

questions.q: add how many times: ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ (three times).
questions.a: For example: أَغْسِلُ وَجْهِي ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ

questions.q: Back to our ponder: what would your hands and feet say?
